title: Palaeoproteomics Protocol for Arid Environment Samples
author: Louise Le Meillour
materials: NH 4 HCO 3 200 mL 50 millimolar (mM) Weigh 0.7906 g of ammonium bicarbonate (Sigma Aldrich). Add the weighed powder to 100 mL of milliQ water. Shake manually until the crystals are dissolved. Make up to 200 mL. Store at room temperature.
MilliQ Water 1 mL Acetic Acid 2.8 µL
Thermomixer 450 rpm, 50 °C, 1 hour Allow the samples to come to room temperature (on the bench, approx. 30 min)
ThermoMixer 350 rpm, 37 °C, 18 hours, Trypsin can act in only 3 to 5h

steps.title: Prepare EDTA solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 mL of 0.5 M EDTA (pH 7.4) under a fume hood using a pH meter and bar magnet.

steps.title: Prepare Iodoacetamide solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 mL of 1 M iodoacetamide solution.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 184.9 mg of iodoacetamide.
Add to 1 mL of milliQ water in a foil-covered or brown microtube.
Shake manually until crystals are dissolved.
Store at -20°C if necessary.

steps.title: Prepare and aliquot Trypsin
steps.instruction: Prepare a trypsin solution and divide into aliquots for storage.

substeps.instruction: Mix 100 µg of Trypsin with 100 µL of MilliQ water and Acetic acid in a tube by ups and downs.
Divide the solution into 10 µL pellets.
Store at -20°C (do not thaw more than 3 times).

steps.title: Prepare cleaning materials
steps.instruction: Prepare paper and EtOH for cleaning between samples.

steps.title: Decalcify samples
steps.instruction: Perform decalcification of bone/tooth samples using EDTA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of EDTA to each sample.
Store at 4°C on a mixing carousel to ensure contact with every particle.
Change the solution once.
Centrifuge at 13400 x g for 1 minute.
Collect supernatants in a tube labeled with the sample code.
Homogenize the mixture via Vortex for 1 minute and store at 4°C.
Continue until decalcification is complete (bone phantom should resemble wet cotton candy).

steps.title: Solubilize and reduce proteins
steps.instruction: Prepare samples for digestion by adding ammonium bicarbonate and DTT.

substeps.instruction: Add 300-500 µL of 50 M ammonium bicarbonate to each sample.
Add 1 µL of 1 M DTT for every 100 µL of sample (final concentration ~10mM).
Add 1.6 µL of 1 M iodoacetamide solution (final concentration approx. 15mM).
Incubate for 30 min in the dark, protected by foil.
Add 1 µL of trypsin (prepared at 1 µg/µL) to 300 μL of solubilisation solution.

steps.title: Stop digestion
steps.instruction: Stop the enzymatic reaction using formic acid.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 10% formic acid solution by mixing 10 µL pure formic acid with 90 µL MilliQ water (adjust volume based on sample count).
Add 1 µL of the prepared 10% formic acid to the sample.
Centrifuge the samples (rpm and temperature not specified) for 10 minutes.
Place 40 to 100 μL of each sample into an insert dedicated to LC-MS/MS analyses with an electrospray source.

steps.title: Clean equipment
steps.instruction: Use ultrasounds to clean the diamond head of the dremel at the end of the process.
